Before Benef could reel in the fish,
Muse reached for both rods at once!{w}
"This rod first -- it's miiine, nyaaa!!"{w}

en:
"Benef, I'm telling you for your own good:
just give it up already."{w}
note: [JP] dropped: 'Mr.' would assign Benef a gender (glossary: no explicit gender).

en: "N-no...{w}I'm going to catch one, no matter what...{w}Waaaaaahhhhh!!"{w}
note: [JP] = wailing sob.

en: "By the way, adventurers.{w}Have you heard of something called catnip water?"{w}{p}"From what I hear, Werebeasts love catnip water more than anything."{w}{p}"Even Muse could be stopped in her tracks if I had some catnip water."{w}
note: Muse = girl (glossary/Wikipedia [JP]), so 'her'.

en: "So...{w}for the sake of my dinner, could you...{w}go and fetch me some catnip water!?"{w}{p}"Catnip water springs up underground in the Nerid Marshlands!"{w}{p}"I-I'm counting on you!{w}In fact, I've already counted on you!{w}I have, you hear!?"{w}
note: Comic shift [JP] -> [JP]: Benef declares the request already made so the party can't refuse. | editorial: tense-shift joke reworded ("counting on you" -> "already counted on you"); the old "consider it asked -- I've asked" was clunky.

en: "...Benef~ What are you talking about, nya?"{w}
"Ah, Muse. Don't you worry about it. Heh heh heh."{w}
"Aren't you fishing today, nyan?"{w}

"Who knows?
Will I fish~? Won't I fish~?"{w}
"...Muse has no use for a Benef who doesn't fish, nyan."{w}
"Please, help me...{w}I'm begging you..."{w}
"Catnip water from the Nerid Marshlands...{w}Please, please, take pity on me...{w}I'm begging you!!"{w}

"Oh, at last...
at last you've brought it to me!{w}Thank you, thank you so much!!"{w}{p}"Then I'll cast my line too!{w}Heh heh heh...{w}Hah hah hah!"{w}
"Th-this much!{w}Was fishing always this much fun!?{w}Fwahahahaha!!"{w}{p}"The fish goes and bites the bait!{w}And goes and tugs!{w}And theeeeeen!!"{w}

"Here it comes, here it comes, here it comeeeees!
My dinner's on the hoooooook!!"{w}
"Heh-hee!!"{w}
note: [JP] read as the same gloating giggle as SCDWMAP:4722 (Benef has the catnip plan ready); could also be a startled squeak as Muse wakes.

en: "I smell yummy fish, nya~{w}Benef, you're fishing for the first time in ages, nyan!"{w}
note: [JP]: Muse remarks Benef is fishing again after a long break (Benef stopped while waiting for the catnip water).

en: "Muse... oh, Muse..."{w}

"It's been a long time.
Ten-odd years since you came to this wharf...{w}It's been sooo looooong!!"{w}
note: editorial: [JP] = "ten-odd years" as in 020 4665.

en:
"Benef, what's wrong, nyan?{w}Dunno what's going on, but
I'll eat it for you, so hurry up and catch it, nyan."{w}
note: [JP] (cat-ified [JP]) kept as casual 'Dunno'.

en: "Take... THIIIIIIIS!!"{w}
note: editorial: [JP] = "Take this!"; "Then eat" added a word and read as food.

en: Benef sprinkled the catnip water all around!{w}
"Nyaaa?{w}What are you doing, nyan? What did you sprinkle, nyan?"{w}
"Well? Feels good, doesn't it!?{w}So good you can't even be bothered to move, eh!!"{w}
"It really does, nya~ It feels so nice, nya~{w}Woozy... woozy..."{w}
"Now, while I've got the chaaaance!!"{w}

"Now, now at last..."{w}
"Good for you, Benef!"{w}

"Thank you!
Adventurers, thank you so very much!"{w}

"After that, I had fish with my dinner
for the first time in ten-odd years."{w}{p}"Who'd have thought a taste I'd forgotten could be so delicious...{w}For the first time in ages, I felt the will to live welling up!"{w}
